title: Do not show the Wi-Fi connection as fully working before confirming if the connection is limited
line: Right after connecting, the network icon now spins and the "connection activated" notification waits until Plasma knows whether the Internet is reachable.
explanation: NetworkManager reports a connection as activated before its first connectivity check finishes (that check can take up to 20 seconds, e.g. while the router is still booting), and keeps the old 'none'/'unknown' connectivity until then. plasma-nm only looked at the activation state, so the tray icon showed a fully working connection and kded sent 'Connection activated', and only later switched to the limited icon and 'Limited Connectivity'. Now, while the check is enabled and still pending for the primary connection, the tray icon shows its busy indicator, and kded holds the 'activated' notification until the result: it is shown when connectivity is full, dropped when it is limited or a captive portal (those have their own notifications), and shown anyway after 30 seconds if no result arrives.

commits.message:
applet, kded: don't show a connection as working before it's checked

Right after a connection activated, the icon and the notification showed
it as working while NetworkManager was still checking whether it reaches
the Internet. Show it as busy and delay the notification until then.

BUG: 513222

media.caption: Connecting to HomeNet while the Internet is unreachable: 'activated' notification and a full Wi-Fi icon, then the limited icon and 'Limited Connectivity' about 25 s later
Same sequence: the icon spins while the check runs, no 'activated' notification, then the limited icon and 'Limited Connectivity'
While the connectivity check is running, the icon already looks fully working
While the check is running, the icon shows the busy indicator

review.text: The cause is right (NM reports Activated before the first connectivity check finishes) and NM exposes no 'check pending' state, so inferring it from connectivity UNKNOWN/NONE is reasonable; delaying the notification with a 30 s fallback and reusing the existing busy indicator adds no strings. However the tray icon has no such fallback: if NM keeps reporting NONE or UNKNOWN for an activated primary connection (check never completes, odd routing), the icon spins forever and looks like it's still connecting.
changes: Bound the icon's busy state with the same timeout used for the notification (e.g. stop treating the connection as 'being checked' 30 s after it became activated)
Optionally move the shared timeout/state into one place so kded and the icon agree
